exactSourceInput:
Busy PM into lean Night — pack carefully.

CREW
SkyLink inbound **22:50** (delayed) — quiet wing **M210–M213** held (4 rooms tonight). Keys + quiet packs ready? HK says M213 still vacant dirty at 17:00 — **priority turn**. Do not sell these.

SPA
Last treatment 20:30; spa doors lock **21:00**. Day member Ms Pell still in robe lounge at 20:10 — **not a hotel guest** — taxi arranged by spa — DONE when she leaves. Do not make her a room arrival.

VALET
Valet ends **23:00**. Two cars still without overnight tickets at 18:40 — need tickets before handoff to Night or cars remain on forecourt. Guest Shore’s friend (not in-house) waiting — not a room folio issue.

SHUTTLE
Last public loop **21:15** — three pax. After that Night does not run shuttle — taxis only.

ANNEX
CX18 noise complaint earlier — guest settled with reloc offer declined — **monitor** only; eng not coming tonight unless worsens.
